description.purpose: The translation between a model's tool round and this library's own lane: a `lib_<op>` call becomes the question `<op>` on `in_lib` of `./query`, under `caller` 'tools' and with the call id as `op_id`; the one answer comes back as one `tool_result` under the call id, its fields as JSON text without `op_id` and `caller`.
description.use_when: Reached on this hive's `in_tool` lane with one tool call (`hop.tool_name`, the arguments as JSON text in the turn), and on `answer` from `./query` when `hop.caller` is 'tools'.
description.not_in_scope: No store and nothing parked: the call id IS the question's `op_id`. No shortening of an answer (`./query` pages every list). No write tool, so no `read_only` refusal.
description.emits_meaning: A question on `in_lib` (hop `op`, `op_id` = 'tools:' + the call id, `caller` 'tools'), or `tool_result` with `tool_call_id` (and `error_code` when `ok` is false). Refused without asking any cell: a name this library does not serve (`tool_unknown`), an argument that does not match the tool's schema or a call without an id (`bad_request`).
description.consumes_meaning: A tool call, and the answers of `./query` to the questions this cell sent.
